mistake_content: Added 'import unittest' statement to the test file
solution:
Remove the 'import unittest' statement. HPX automation framework uses pytest as the test framework, not unittest. According to KB Section 1 (Architecture Overview) and Section 7.1 (Test File Anatomy), all HPX tests are pytest-based and should only import pytest and FlowContainer-related modules. The correct imports should be:

import pytest
from MobileApps.libs.flows.windows.hpx_rebranding.flow_container import FlowContainer

Action: Delete line 'import unittest' from the file.

Revert the class inheritance back to 'object'. According to KB Section 7.1 (Test File Anatomy & Conventions), the standard test class structure explicitly shows:

class Test_Suite_XX_<FeatureName>(object):

HPX test classes MUST inherit from 'object', NOT 'unittest.TestCase'. The framework uses pytest's class-based test organization with pytest fixtures, not unittest's TestCase pattern.

Action: Change 'class Test_Suite_01_Add_Shortcut(unittest.TestCase):' to 'class Test_Suite_01_Add_Shortcut(object):'

mistake_content: Removed '_C49' suffix from test_04 method name
solution:
Restore the TestRail case ID suffix '_C49' to the test method name. According to KB Section 7.1 (Test File Anatomy) and Section 20.1 (Naming Conventions), ALL test methods MUST include the TestRail case ID suffix in the format:

def test_XX_<description>_C<testrail_id>(self):

The TestRail case ID suffix (e.g., _C49) is mandatory for traceability between automated tests and TestRail test cases. This enables proper test result reporting and linkage to the TestRail test management system.

Action: Rename the test method from 'test_04_verify_the_screen_when_the_user_clicks_on_go_back_button' back to 'test_04_verify_the_screen_when_the_user_clicks_on_go_back_button_C49'
